paragraphs: AI is reshaping how financial institutions manage, protect, and extract value from their data at scale. At the heart of this shift is content: the advisory agreements that win mandates, the suitability files that satisfy regulators, and the client records that carry a relationship for decades. Content makes up 90%¹ of an organization's data — and it's massively underutilized.
By combining Content + AI, Intelligent Content Management helps Meridian gain insights from content, automate mission-critical workflows with agentic AI, and protect client data at scale.

main.heading: Move at the speed of AI with Box
paragraphs: Intelligent Content Management is the key to getting more from your content and realizing meaningful business results, from faster decision-making to improving your bottom line. Unlock the value within your content by asking questions of your data, extracting insights, and automating workflows with customizable AI agents.

items.title: Enterprise-grade artificial intelligence
paragraphs: **Enterprise-first:** Access AI right where your content lives; ask questions and get instant insights.
**AI agents:** Tailored agents for the task, no code required.

items.title: Advanced data protection and compliance
paragraphs: **Threat detection:** Protect against malware and ransomware, and recover from attacks if they happen.

items.title: Modern workflow and collaboration
paragraphs: **Real-time collaboration:** Note-taking and whiteboarding, for everyone, anywhere.
**AI data extraction:** Pull data from documents to fuel automated workflows.

items.title: Flexible and interoperable platform
paragraphs: **Interoperability:** 1,500+ deep integrations with productivity and system-of-record tools.
**Developer tools:** Rich APIs for custom, content-centric experiences.
